response.title: which power station runs a pellet stove the longest
response.answer:
For running a pellet stove during a power outage, the power station with the largest usable battery capacity (Wh) will generally run it the longest, provided its inverter can handle the stove's startup power.

I'd focus on large expandable power stations from EcoFlow, Bluetti, Jackery, and Anker rather than smaller portable batteries.

A typical pellet stove uses approximately:

100–200 watts while running, depending on the model and settings.

300–600 watts or more briefly during ignition.

Less power on some models once the stove is fully heated.

For comparison, I'll use a 150-watt continuous load and assume 85% of the battery capacity is usable after inverter losses.
